cohort: 310 newborns with sepsis admitted to a tertiary care center nursery in Northern India
finding: 3.87% of neonates with sepsis developed AKI, and while meningitis was significantly associated with AKI,  maternal age, sex, birth weight, gestational age, asphyxia, maternal sepsis risk factors, meconium-stained liquor, and mode of delivery were not.
